faces.name: The Clone Saga
faces.oracleText:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Surveil 3.
II — When you next cast a creature spell this turn, copy it, except the copy isn't legendary.
III — Choose a card name. Whenever a creature with the chosen name deals combat damage to a player this turn, draw a card.

faces.name: The Cloning of Shredder
faces.oracleText:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Exile target creature card from your graveyard. Create a token that's a copy of it, except it isn't legendary and is a Mutant in addition to its other types.
II, III — Create a token that's a copy of a card exiled with this Saga, except it isn't legendary and is a Mutant in addition to its other types.

faces.name: The Cobra King
faces.oracleText:
At the beginning of each player's upkeep, create a 1/1 blue Serpent creature token named Cobra Coil. When you do, if you control five or more Snakes and/or Serpents, choose one —
• Strike first — Target Snake or Serpent you control fights target creature an opponent controls.
• Strike hard — Put a +1/+1 counter on each Snake and Serpent you control.

faces.name: The Collector
faces.oracleText:
Whenever you cast a signed spell or play a signed land, copy it. (A signed card is a card signed by its artist, designer, or someone else it's strongly associated with.)
Discard a signed card: Destroy target creature with a name that has a five or fewer letter length difference from the person who signed the discarded card.

faces.name: The Colossal Dreadmaw
faces.oracleText:
Trample
You may cast creature cards from your hand as though they were the card Colossal Dreadmaw. (They become Colossal Dreadmaws.)

faces.name: The Coming of Galactus
faces.oracleText:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after IV.)
I — Destroy up to one target nonland permanent.
II, III — Each opponent loses 2 life.
IV — Create Galactus, a legendary 16/16 black Elder Alien creature token with flying, trample, and "Whenever Galactus attacks, destroy target land."

faces.name: The Commander Recommender
faces.oracleText:
When The Commander Recommender enters, bring out another Commander deck you own without revealing the commander. Reveal fifteen cards at random from it other than the commander. Each opponent guesses the deck's commander, then reveal it. (The deck must be a legit Commander deck, not just The Ur-Dragon and 99 Islands. Respect the minigame.)
Whenever an opponent guesses wrong (like to Liar's Pendulum... or the above effect), you draw two cards.

faces.name: The Command Zone
faces.oracleText:
When you planeswalk here, each player who controls their commander draws a card. Other players may put their commander from the command zone onto the battlefield.
If an ability of your commander would trigger during your turn, that ability triggers an additional time.
Whenever chaos ensues, the number of times each commander has been cast from the command zone becomes 0. (This resets commander tax.)
